items.title: Impossible Objects superpowers VFX production with AI models running on HP ZGX Nano
items.excerpt: LA studio Impossible Objects is running AI models locally on HP ZGX Nano desktops so artists can fold generative steps into an existing VFX pipeline without shipping plates to the cloud. The piece details how artist-driven AI workflows sit alongside traditional comp and 3D tools.

items.title: Nura Studios Debuts 'Rainbow Hollow' Stop-Motion Styled AI Series
items.excerpt: Noah Wagner's new series was produced on Nura's Showcraft platform, which handles story, layout, animation, edit and post finishing inside one environment. The system opens to the public in early September.

items.title: Nura Launches First Original Animated Series 'Rainbow Hollow' Built with Showcraft AI-Assisted Platform
items.excerpt: Nura's first original series is a stop-motion-styled show made end to end on its Showcraft AI-assisted production platform. Creator Noah Wagner built the story out of his own experience of loss.

items.title: Bob Gaudette and Kirk Hipkiss Launch AI Film and TV Production Studio Nolia
items.excerpt: The Toronto studio is built around original IP, with 'The Little Cloud Thief' in development as both a feature and a series. Gaudette's 8-minute AI short took the $50K Grand Prix at this year's Runway AI Festival.

items.title: A New Free Seminar Teaches Documentary Filmmakers When and How to Opt Out of AI
items.excerpt: Field of Vision and Freedom of the Press Foundation are running the sixth edition of their Digital Security Clinic, this time on AI. It walks documentary teams through where AI enters their pipeline and how to opt out of it.

items.title: Epic Spaceman Uses Animation, VFX To Explain Science. Without AI
items.excerpt: Toby Lockerbie explains how self-taught animation and VFX turned Epic Spaceman into one of YouTube's biggest science channels. He also lays out why genAI has no place in his production process.

items.title: Brad Pitt Says AI Could Help More 'Mid-Budget Films' Get Made if It's 'Used as a Tool'
items.excerpt: Pitt argues AI could make the squeezed $40M-$90M tier of movies viable again if it stays a tool rather than a replacement. He frames the next few years as an open experiment for producers.

items.title: James Gray Says AI Is 'Worthless' and Young People Won't Stand for It
items.excerpt: Collecting Locarno's lifetime achievement award, the 'Paper Tiger' director calls generative AI creatively worthless. He bets audiences have a real hunger for honest, human-made work.

items.title: 'Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO' Director Kamiyama Kenji Built His New Series Around a Metaphor for AI Fears
items.excerpt: Kamiyama Kenji says the new Gundam series is a deliberate metaphor for anxieties about AI: 'Will we end up being used by it?' He discusses how that theme shaped the show's design and storytelling.

items.title: Snapchat Banning Entirely AI-Generated Videos From Its Spotlight Platform
items.excerpt: Snapchat will bar fully AI-generated clips from Spotlight while still allowing creators to use AI to edit or enhance footage they shot. The line it draws is a working definition short-form creators now have to design around.

items.title: Locarno Honoree Sigurjón Sighvatsson on AI, Netflix and Why Cannes "Doesn't Know What It Is Anymore"
items.excerpt: The 'Wild at Heart' producer talks about how AI and streaming are reshaping what independent producers can actually get made. He argues smaller festivals will outlast the mega-cinema era.

items.title: Locarno Pro Takes on the Big Issues: AI, "Algorithms and Consolidation Versus Creative Freedom"
items.excerpt: Locarno's industry strand builds its 2026 program around 'power, people, data,' putting AI and algorithmic distribution at the center. Industry head Markus Duffner explains why that framing is timely for filmmakers.

items.title: Vida Scene Search: AI Scene-Level Search, No Manual Logging Required
items.excerpt: Vida added an offline AI indexing layer to its Content OS MAM so post teams can search inside video libraries at the moment level. It removes the dependency on metadata that was hand-logged years ago.

items.title: The Filmmakers at Wonder Dynamics Building AI for Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Wonder Dynamics co-founders Tye Sheridan and Nikola Todorovic explain how their filmmaking backgrounds shaped Autodesk Flow Studio. They cover transferring live-action performance onto CG characters while keeping VFX pipeline compatibility.

items.title: Peacock Launches First Serialized Mobile Game 'Public Eye'
items.excerpt: Peacock's first episodic interactive title comes out of NBCUniversal's pact with Wolf Games, the generative-AI startup co-founded by Elliot Wolf. It is a test of AI-generated serialized storytelling built by a TV production house.
